snippet.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite – Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is now available for pre-order on PC,
PlayStation and Xbox. And the best: You get a special bonus with the Firestation Companion Pack if you pre-order the game until its release on September 09, 2025.

💌 Wishlist the game now: https://www.firefighting-simulator.com/en/

Cross-play allows players to work together across platforms, while integrated voice chat enables seamless communication and precise task assignment. The fire station of the fictive map “Oakridge City” serves as a central starting point from which missions can be launched and the appropriate vehicles selected. 

Different extinguishing methods are available. Players can now switch between straight stream and spray mode, or switch to foam on the fire truck to tackle different types of fire more effectively. Dangerous situations such as gas leaks, flue gas explosions, liquid or electrical fires require quick action, as well as locating and shutting off electrical boxes and gas valves. In addition, the targeted sawing of roofs enables vertical ventilation to allow smoke to escape and provide better visibility, while ladders facilitate access to higher locations.

Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is published by astragon Entertainment, developed by weltenbauer. Software Entwicklung GmbH, and supported by the Federal Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate Action. The new game from the developers of the Construction Simulator franchise is powered by Unreal Engine 5 and will be on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S in Fall 2025. Physical copies will be available in select countries.

🧑‍🚒 What you can expect from Firefighting Simulator: Ignite 🧑‍🚒

UNITED AGAINST FIRE. Face unpredictable dangers head-on, fight perilous fires with your crew and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter in a sprawling city in the American Midwest, where every mission pushes your skills to the limit. Experience the rush of firefighting in stunning visual quality in an intuitive and cooperative multiplayer mode with 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members. Battle raging and dynamic flames, heat and smoke, all simulated in real-time with the cutting-edge physics and graphics systems powered by Unreal Engine 5, letting you immerse yourself in firefighting in a never-before-experienced way.

During your career, cope with various challenging situations like trapped civilians, electric fires, flammable liquids, grease fires, backdrafts, flashovers and explosions. Arm yourself with authentic firefighting tools including fire hoses, saws, halligan tools, axes or extinguishers and use faithfully recreated fire engines and ladder trucks. Use the right tactics and methods with precision to put out blazing flames. Each mission requires real-life firefighting strategies, for instance ventilate to reduce fire spread, cool down overheated objects, saw through obstacles, reduce air drafts, select the proper extinguishing agent.

So when the emergency call is coming in, get the job done by taking the shortest route to the emergency scene, fight fires and save lives together.

Features of the game:

🧑‍🚒  EVERYDAY HERO: Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter
‍🔥 IGNITE YOUR PASSION: fight perilous fires in single- and multiplayer mode
4️⃣ TEAMWORK: 4-Player coop-mode
📢 UNITED AGAINST FIRE: fill up your squad with an NPC crew when in singleplayer-mode
🧯 AUTHENTICITY: use equipment from leading US firefighting brands such as HAIX®, Fire-Dex, STIHL and Leatherhead Tools
🚒 QUICK RESPONSE: drive faithfully reproduced licensed Rosenbauer America fire trucks, such as TP3® Pumper, Viper®, Roadrunner 68 and more
👩‍🚒 YOUR CAREER: choose between 6 characters and different outfit sets
🏢 FIRESTATION: your hub for learning techniques and choosing your next emergency mission(s). 
🔥 SIMULATION: realistic fire, heat, water and smoke simulation thanks to Unreal Engine 5 physics engine
💻 MODDING PC: create missions and share them via Mod.io
🎮 MODDING CONSOLES: download and play mission mods from the Mod.io hub
